title: Retrying a failed skill check (e.g. dragging the skiff free, pressing Aldous, settling the door, searching hearing rolls) raises the DC each time, which is well-telegraphed, but there's no way to see the cap ('stops at 20/23/27') until after several fails; a single upfront mention of the scaling rule would help players decide whether to keep retrying.
